name: Hell Hold'em
detailed_description:
In Hell, demons play dirty. To survive, you have to play dirtier.

Hell Hold’em is a tactical roguelike where poker becomes the language of combat. Battle cunning demons in corrupted Texas Hold’em duels, bending the rules with unholy tricks to survive. Upgrade and customize your Infernal Deck, descend through the seven circles, and face the ultimate choice: will you cleanse your sins… or add new ones to the pile?

Cheat to survive

Hiding an ace up your sleeve. Swapping cards when no one’s looking. Burning your opponent’s winning hand. In Hell Hold’em, cheating is the core of your combat. Master over [Podemos poner un número?] tricks to break the rules and turn the tide when the odds are stacked against you.

Seven circles of hell, seven sins, hundres of demons

Descend through a labyrinth of sins. Each circle introduces unique demons with unique cheating styles, stats and combat styles. Some manipulate your hand, others alter the shared pot, and a few shatter the rules entirely. Every duel forces you to rethink your strategy.

Infernal deck

Your deck is more than a weapon. It’s the only thing that survives between runs. Add new suits, wild cards, and special effects to customize your deck’s powers, making it stronger and more corrupted with every descent.

More deeper in hell, more rewards

Defeating demons yields powerful rewards: new cards, magical items, abilities, or permanent upgrades to your Infernal Deck. Customize suits, add special effects, and shape your deck to prepare for future battles.

Beyond the table

Special encounters, card-based puzzles, and minigames break the rhythm of battle and offer new ways to cheat your way forward.

Upgrade your infernal deck, descend through the seven circles, and learn to play dirtier than demons themselves. Would you cleanse your sins… or add new ones to the pile?
